svg.title: Skate Judge direct-LiPo editable wiring project preview

polyline.title: STEMMA QT switched 3.3 V → IMU VIN

svg.text: Editable wiring layout · power disconnected while wiring · not a production PCB design
Red: switched 3.3 V · black: GND · blue: SDA / GPIO3
· yellow: SCL / GPIO4. GPIO7 enables this rail; no
V. R1: recommended 330 Ω, near DIN.
Feather 3.3V to 3V; GND to GND. SCK/GPIO36 to CLK, MOSI/GPIO35 to DI, MISO/GPIO37 to DO,
GPIO10 to CS. Leave 5V and CD unconnected. Use short wires. Insert a FAT32 card before power-
on. Firmware selects SD if mounted, otherwise internal flash. Stop and save before switching
Direct LiPo is a bench-test option: this RGB stick is specified for 4–7 V, so operation below 4 V is not guaranteed. Test fully charged and
partly discharged. Verify JST polarity. Insulate and protect the battery. Crossings without a junction are not connections.
